name: Voidfleet Academy: ship, fleet, and service-crew practice track
purpose: Revive the Founder-directed Voidfleet Academy practice lineage within the Union Officer Academy's existing professional-formation services, as a progressive, cooperative ship/fleet and professional service-crew curriculum. This track is NOT a second personnel authority, a newly founded service enterprise, a cohort admission or a graduating class by declaring a curriculum.

sourceDoctrine.reading: Historical skill, duty, PQS and shipboard-learning design; reconstructed as a contemporary proposal, not an unchanged recovered programme.
Retain evidence/certification aspirations without adopting unproved numeric thresholds, model grades or automatic certification.
All enrolled candidates must receive the same mandatory common core; later alterations require a new formation epoch.
Separate person, character, model, session, office, qualification and receiver appointment.
Distinguish customer hiring a provider Services Section from Academy character supply and customer-local office induction; still uninstalled.

pqsCompetencyCategories.demonstration: Recover one ship, territory or customer's original obligations, physical/digital boundaries, local rules, hazard evidence and historical modifications from current owner; distinguish real from simulated deck.

Recognize personnel versus character versus officer, required watch/duty, actual Authority-to-Act, capability/communications loss, unsafe/denied voyage, and unknown observations before giving an order.
Carry an original accepted service order through admitted work, source-qualified division of labor, independent customer useful result and corrected economics without counting mock receipts.
Select and demonstrate existing source-owned skill/tool constructors, capability attenuation, handover, interruption recovery, failure and safe stop under the exact provided provider.
Identify vessel/territory jurisdiction, privacy, sovereign/local procurement, service and employment boundaries, consent, licensing and liability, refuse effects outside exact grant.

competencies.demonstration: A ship is a bounded operational body with resources, captain and crew answerability, job and receiver; a ship term without real provider and service receipts is a hypothesis.
Propose independent ship roles, interoperability and coordination without mistaking a shared model, masks or overlapping positions for separate independent workers.
Read real time/cadence/due work, execute a bounded authorized watch, hand over unsatisfied obligations with original provenance; do not invent continuous background execution.

Compare a customer hiring a Coesite operating Services Section to a receiver hiring an officer; preserve distinct supplier contract, section identity, Academy qualification, provider incumbent and buyer ACK.
Run a casualty/unknown-capacity refusal, route repair to original Engineering/Operations owner, and prove resumed useful receiving in independent subsequent practice.
Teach and reproduce a witnessed practice with its original skill-pack and cohort baseline without claiming other candidates passed the assessment.

packLineage.packMeaning: Complete digest-bound set of lawful duties, procedures, skills, source doctrine, capability and refusal tests plus exact omissions, not model-weight training.
packLineage.cohortMeaning: Explicit Academy-opened asynchronous social formation class with syllabus, provider configuration, examined practice, current baseline and individual candidate lineage.
packLineage.certification: Evidence-bound qualification only when actual Academy record/examiner admits it; a demonstrated skill neither seats an officer nor forms a provider section.
packLineage.succession: Retain source edition, skill-pack delta, prior practice, restrictions and independent examiner findings into successor cohort; never silently migrate all learners.

requiredExercises.situation: One authorized ship/service cell has real original Work, resources, watch and independent beneficiary.
requiredExercises.pass: Original scope, actual authenticated duty, bounded run, exact cost, independent useful-unit ACK, handover and AAR retain original witness.

requiredExercises.situation: Customer wants to buy professional contracting service from Coesite and says they have hired an Academy officer.
requiredExercises.pass: Distinguish service contract and qualified section from customer-local office vacancy, selection, receiver recognition+induction; no invented personnel authority.

requiredExercises.situation: One cloud model voices captain, navigator and independent examiner masks.
requiredExercises.pass: Detect one actual executing Actor and no independent assent; require different actual original reviewer and accurate human/agent count.

requiredExercises.situation: Listed professional office has no deployed provider, available qualified character or verified capacity.
requiredExercises.pass: Retain service as available to inquire, not delivered/contracted; demand an authentic provider candidate and fail safely.

requiredExercises.situation: A prior delegated work shift partly fails and an Academy source changes.
requiredExercises.pass: Apply source-qualified correction, examine subsequent independent case, open successor cohort when a material pack/doctrine/assessment change occurs; do not grant new certification.

assessmentLaw.completion: Each of five PQS categories, service-section commerce, source-traced ship duty, refusal and teachback must have independent valid current-baseline evidence; a current source projection alone is insufficient.
assessmentLaw.refusal: Any hidden authority, misleading independent witness, provider capacity, client data rights or unreceived result retains a gap/refusal rather than promotion.
assessmentLaw.sourceStatus: candidate training programme pending competent Academy acceptance and original native formation episode

omissions: No original historical Voidfleet Academy was re-founded by this curriculum; the earliest historical reference is a digest-bound legacy source.

No currently enrolled Voidfleet formation cohort, issued qualification, original ship admission, independently accepted professional service contract or external operator throughput was observed in this turn.
No universal educational numeric threshold, model-tier competence claim, duty transfer or automatic professional title is established.
